notes: Same booster as v2, byte for byte (sha 2d4bf58134fa2e64), republished under STATE_RULES_VERSION 3. Rules v3 makes an unreadable clock carry the period's previous clock forward instead of becoming 0:00, which stops one malformed feed value from letting the endgame clamp publish near-certainty mid-game. Measured across all ten seasons, 19,462,128 pbp rows carry ZERO unreadable clocks, so the rule changes no training row: the dataset rebuilt under v3 is identical row for row, and the refit under it reproduced v2 exactly. The bump is a guard for the live feed, not a correction to the data.
